evidence_proposition: For the PAG `x o-> y`, the generalized-adjustment envelope examines two completions (`x -> y` and `x <-> y`), neither of which carries an adjustment certificate: the effect is not identified by the implemented adjustment method (identified weight 0, unidentified weight 2), and each completion states its own reason.
limitations: Conservative refusal of the implemented generalized-adjustment method on one envelope. Two cases means two completions were examined, not that either supplies an adjustment certificate. It does not claim the effect is unidentifiable by any method, and it does not claim a zero effect for any completion: a directed edge in a MAG/PAG can represent influence together with latent confounding. It does not validate the PAG itself.
